items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: But like Miele, Paul Barnes, all that's my relatives... Very close too. Sisters and brothers, children, you know.

ctx.x: That's where Paul Barbering used to live, you know?
Well, yeah, well, all that before my time, you know. Like Paul, those bars, he raised before my time.
What did Alex Frasier play like? Who would you say sounded like, anybody?
